name: Global Unichip Corp.
summary: Global Unichip Corp. engages in the research and development, production, testing, and sale of embedded memory and logic components, analog components, cell libraries, and EDA tools for various IC applications. It offers ASIC and wafer products, as well as non-recurring engineering services. The company also provides product design, technical support, and consulting services.
